sentences.en: Juha bought bread for three days.

sentences.ar: הוא שם אותו על השולחן והלך לישון.
sentences.en: He put it on the table and went to sleep.
In the morning he saw that bread was missing.
He said: there is a mouse in the house.

sentences.ar: למחרת חסרו גם הלחם וגם החלב.
sentences.en: The next day both the bread and the milk were missing.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: עכשיו יש לי עכבר וחתול.
sentences.en: Juha said: now I have a mouse and a cat.
